text: She slept with a sickle across her throat. Every night.
And a little iron padlock, locked round her big toe.
When I asked why, she said, so I stay where I'm put.
She made me promise. When she died, both would go in the coffin with her.
I'm thirty now. We buried her last week.
The undertaker wouldn't do it. And vampires aren't real. So I didn't push.
Last night, the drawer was open.
There was soil on the floor. Wet. Bare footprints.
That sickle was never keeping anything away from her.
It was keeping her in the ground.
Then something cold closed round my big toe.
So you stay where you're put.
